text:
Registered residential sales reached 10,333 units in the last four weeks, representing a value of AED 29,407,478,845. This volume is 2.2% higher than the previous four-week period. Mortgage registrations totaled 4,035, which are tracked separately from sales transactions. The off-plan share of sales stood at 60%, down from 65% in the prior period.

The median residential price per square foot was AED 1,678, a 1.1% decrease from the previous four weeks. Top performing areas by sales volume include Dubai South with 3,684 units and Jumeirah Village Circle with 2,308 units. Business Bay recorded a 5.0% decline in median price per square foot over the last 12 weeks, while Down Town Jabal Ali saw a 1.6% increase.

Ejari data shows 92,517 contracts registered, with 50% being renewals. The median residential rent is AED 70,000 per year. Estimated gross yields are highest in Zaabeel First at 9.1% and International City Ph 1 at 8.6%. Town Square, Dubai Sports City, and Dubai Production City all show yields of 7.0%, 6.6%, and 6.6% respectively.

Watch-list items include Al Yufrah 1 with a 37.7% price increase and Palm Deira with a 13.8% decrease over 12 weeks. The anomaly monitor flagged 1,027 sales in the last 60 days priced more than 35% away from comparable medians. Figures are based on registered DLD data and Ejari contracts, using medians and benchmark filters that exclude bulk deals, partial shares, mortgages, gifts, and statistical outliers.

facts.ranking_rule: communities with at least 30 eligible sales in both 12-week windows; yields also need 30 rent contracts of the same property type
